quarterly_data.signal: Product portfolio (deck): Auras calls itself an 'HPC Thermal Solution Pioneer' providing total thermal solutions - liquid cooling (Cold Plate + CDU + CDM + QD total solution) and air cooling (HP/VC/3DVC thermal modules). Its AI liquid cooling solution comprises cold plates, DIMM cold plates, quick disconnects, internal, rack, AI and building manifolds, sidecars, RPUs, liquid-to-liquid and liquid-to-air CDUs, in-row CDUs and a 450kW power shelf (DC48V/DC400V). Worldwide sites: Taiwan, China (Hefei, Guangzhou, Chongqing, Kunshan) and Thailand.
